# Navigato

> MIT travel-booking React library (`@navigato/react`) and docs. Multi-brand: Navigato (Obsidian) and Nox & Vale (Gallery). Index only — query the linked files before generating UI. Never emit `@/components/ui` from memory.

`@navigato/react@0.2.0` is unpublished. Booking parts are `preview`, not `stable`. Changelog: [CHANGELOG.md](./CHANGELOG.md).

## Repo

- [DESIGN.md](./DESIGN.md): quality bar, tokens, density, agent control plane
- [AGENTS.md](./AGENTS.md): standing agent rules
- [CHANGELOG.md](./CHANGELOG.md): 0.2.x SERP / PDP floor + remaining booking docs (unpublished)
- [Public exports](./packages/navigato/src/index.ts): `@navigato/react` API
- [Component registry](./apps/docs/src/content/components/registry.ts): purpose, status, when/when-not, props
- [Page demos](./apps/docs/src/components/demos/v2/PageDemos.tsx): SERP, PDP, checkout
- [Nox & Vale gallery](./apps/docs/src/components/demos/v2/NoxValeDemo.tsx): fashion/object product page
- [Getting started](./apps/docs/src/pages/getting-started.astro): consume from the repo; do not assume npm
